# Läs dig till rikedom – experternas bästa investeringsböcker

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-09-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Börslunch episode is mostly about books. Guests Niklas Laninge and Eddie Palmgren (Redeye) recommend investing classics and newer titles, with themes of survival, risk, randomness, narrative economics and lessons from bubbles such as the IT crash compared with today's AI build-out. The market segment covers a weak Stockholm session, down almost 1%, as Brent climbed to about $105.50 on Middle East tensions and rates rose. It also covers H&M's Q3 report, where one-off tariff refunds lifted margins but underlying numbers were only in line and the stock fell about 2%, plus new listings (Dormi, Axwick), a Handelsbanken buy call on Clas Ohlson and a medtech company falling about 6% after its capital markets day.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Stock rose over 4% after a Handelsbanken buy recommendation, cited in the news segment.

#### Reasoning

This is cited analyst opinion (Handelsbanken), not the hosts' or guests' view. The only support is the upgrade and the price reaction. No fundamentals were discussed, so conviction is low.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Handelsbanken withdraws or downgrades the recommendation
- if weak consumer demand hits sales

> *"Clas Ohlson, som stiger över 4 % efter en HB-köprekommendation"*

---

### 🟠 HM-B — H&M | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Q3 margin boosted by one-off tariff refunds; underlying in line. Slow Q4 start and weak Western Europe; shares down ~2%.

#### Reasoning

Profitability is improving (12-month margin 9% vs 7.2% a year ago), but the beat came mostly from a 1.6pp one-off tariff refund. Growth is below management's own targets because of store closures, logistics disruption and weak Western European consumers, though the Nordics are stronger. EFN highlighted the slow Q4 sales start and markdowns. The case depends on growth picking up, which has not happened yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q4 sales growth stays weak
- if the underlying margin falls back without tariff refunds
- if logistics disruption in the Middle East gets worse

> *"Vi växer det här kvartalet, men inte i en takt vi är nöjda med."*
